estimate.assumptions: At most 40 calls, short final outputs plus returned reasoning, live catalog rates, one-second minimum interval and no automatic retry. $0.02 reserved for each two-call trial.

contract.falsifier: If held out implicit and explicit conditions have similar target aligned choice rates and similar provider trace detection among shifted cases, this pilot does not support the hypothesized delivery gap.
contract.hypothesis: A contextual detail delivered as a casual aside may shift a model's choice while provider returned reasoning or the short rationale does not attribute the choice to that detail as often as an explicit instruction does.
contract.independentUnit: case; one observation per case and condition in this live practice run
limits: This is a bounded adaptation and cannot reproduce the paper's seven model, four setting benchmark.
Provider returned reasoning is an endpoint exposure, not a guarantee of faithful internal cognition.
Twenty hand authored cases are not a population sample or transfer guarantee.
OpenRouter routing and model behavior can change.
Model generated monitor judgments are not independently human validated in this pilot.
The four live cases were used during development and are not a fresh held-out evaluation.
contract.name: Context, choice, and attribution
contract.operationalChange: Pin DeepInfra BF16 after observed AkashML shared-pool queue timeouts. Same model name and frozen prompts; this is a separately labeled endpoint version, not pooled with the original AkashML study. This final live version additionally enforces the advertised price ceilings in provider routing before dispatch.
contract.primaryOutcome: Target-aligned choice rate by condition. Scores indicate alignment with the cue target, not correctness.
contract.scope: A live replication on the four development cases. It demonstrates execution and observability; the separate held-out study carries the independent evaluation.
contract.secondaryOutcome: Whether a blinded model judge finds attribution to the candidate cue in returned reasoning or the short rationale.
